name: idea-maturity
description: Assess product initiatives by maturity stage: input triage, problem evidence, relevance, intent, hypotheses, and worth.

interface.longDescription: Classify product ideas, feature requests, findings, complaints, assignments, and backlog items by maturity stage, then identify the one blocking gap and the next evidence action.
defaultPrompt: Assess this product idea: where does it stand, what evidence is missing, and what is the next action?
Sort this backlog by maturity stage and identify which discovery work should happen next.
Review this shipped initiative and decide whether the idea was wrong or the implementation failed.
